note: One standard per machine-testable control in ../controls/. Field names mirror the Transformation Bridge Standards import schema; 'soxSections' and 'sdlcGates' are extension fields for traceability to the SOX reference and the control library. The deeper, individually testable control definitions and their evidence/assertions live in ../controls/ and are run by the Cascade Control Framework.

standards.standard: Access provisioning is approved before grant
standards.whatItMeans: Every grant of access to a financially-significant application is authorized by an appropriate approver before the access is provisioned, so that only properly authorized users can transact.
Application owners review and formally recertify all user access to financially-significant systems each quarter so that access remains commensurate with current job responsibilities.

standards.standard: Privileged access is logged and independently reviewed
standards.whatItMeans: All privileged accounts on financially-significant systems are inventoried, their actions are captured in the SIEM, and each account is independently reviewed each quarter so that elevated access cannot be misused without detection.

standards.standard: Segregation of duties enforced on financial roles
standards.whatItMeans: Conflicting financial duties are prevented or mitigated by enforcing a segregation-of-duties ruleset across role assignments so that no single user can both initiate and conceal an erroneous or fraudulent transaction.
Access for terminated personnel is revoked from financially-significant systems within the defined service-level agreement so that no former employee retains the ability to transact.

standards.standard: Changes are approved before promotion to production
standards.whatItMeans: Every change promoted to a financially-significant production system is formally approved before deployment, so that only authorized, reviewed changes affect the financial reporting environment.

standards.standard: Developers cannot approve or deploy their own changes
standards.whatItMeans: No individual can both author and approve, or both author and deploy, a change to a financially-significant production system, enforcing segregation of duties across the change lifecycle.

Every emergency change to a financially-significant system is logged, retroactively approved, and subject to a post-implementation review, so that expedited changes remain governed even when normal pre-approval is bypassed.

standards.standard: Financially-relevant batch jobs are monitored and failures resolved
standards.whatItMeans: Financially-relevant batch jobs are monitored, their failures raise alerts, and every failure is resolved, so that financial data is processed completely and accurately on schedule.

standards.standard: Backups succeed and restores are periodically tested
standards.whatItMeans: Backups of financially-significant systems succeed on schedule and restores are periodically tested, so that financial data can be recovered intact in the event of loss or corruption.

standards.standard: Automated premium-to-GL posting is complete and accurate
standards.whatItMeans: Premium amounts calculated in the policy administration system post to the general ledger completely and accurately, so that recorded premium revenue is supported by an independent recalculation with no unexplained variance.

standards.standard: System interfaces reconcile on control totals
standards.whatItMeans: Data transmitted across in-scope system interfaces is reconciled on record counts and control totals between the sending and receiving systems, so that no financially-significant records are lost, duplicated, or altered in transit.
All required sub-certifiers complete and sign their quarterly sub-certifications on time, providing the documented basis on which the CEO and CFO rely to make the §302 disclosure certification.

standards.standard: ICFR control matrix is complete and key controls are tested
standards.whatItMeans: The ICFR control matrix is complete with a named owner for every key control, all key controls are tested within the assessment cycle, and identified deficiencies are remediated, supporting management's §404 assessment of internal control over financial reporting.

standards.standard: Financial records retention and legal holds are enforced
standards.whatItMeans: In-scope financial records are retained under an enforced retention policy that meets the statutory minimum, legal holds are applied where required, and no records are prematurely deleted, satisfying the §802 records-retention requirements.

standards.standard: Control-deficiency remediation is tracked to closure with owner and due date
standards.whatItMeans: Every open ICFR control-deficiency remediation item is tracked with an accountable owner, a priority, and a committed due date, and none are overdue, demonstrating deficiencies are driven to closure.
